# dnswiz_ipam_available_ip (Data Source)

Finds the next free host address in a network, without allocating it. It's a read-time peek — for concurrency-safe allocation, create a `dnswiz_ipam_ip_address` with no `address` instead.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dnswiz_ipam_available_ip" "next" {
  network_id = dnswiz_ipam_network.app.id
}

output "next_free_ip" {
  value = data.dnswiz_ipam_available_ip.next.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) ID of the network to look in.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The next free host address, e.g. `10.1.5.10`.
